verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's developer portal serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of many developer pages (ai-models.md, hpc-sdk.md, brev.md, the cuML/cuDF pages), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for the H200's software ecosystem. Coverage is portal-wide rather than H200-specific, and some pages have no markdown version: cuda-toolkit.md returns 404. Missing for 10: H200-specific agent-readable docs (the H200 product page is not shown in llms.txt or as .md), consistent .md coverage (e.g., CUDA Toolkit), and hands-on corroboration of agent use.
